item.title: SMPD_PS for ACM_RFI# 528310 - Master Equipment Supply Agreement
item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-10-30

The New York City Housing Authoritys (NYCHA) Asset and Capital Management Division is seeking input (Responses) from manufacturers and suppliers of auger compactors and interior compactors on a proposed Master Equipment Supply Agreement.

 

Under this new procurement approach, NYCHA would enter into an agreement with a qualified manufacturer or supplier, establishing pre-negotiated terms, conditions, and unit pricing for equipment to be supplied across multiple NYCHA developments. NYCHAs project-specific installation contractors would issue Purchase Orders against the agreement as equipment is needed, while payment obligations to the supplier would remain with NYCHA.

This RFI is available online through NYCHAs Oracle iSupplier system (iSupplier). Instructions for registering for iSupplier can be found at  http://www1.nyc.gov/site/nycha/business/vendors.page.

item.title: SMD_SMALL PURCHASE MAINTENANCE OF OFFSET PRINTING EQUIPMENT AT 23 ASH STREET, BROOKLYN, NY AND 90 CHURCH STREET, NEW YORK, NY
item.description:
Housing Authority | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-08-28

The New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) seeks bids from qualified vendors to furnish all labor, materials, equipment, supervision, insurance, and all other items necessary to provide preventive maintenance and repair services for NYCHAs offset printing equipment located at 23 Ash Street, Brooklyn, NY 11222, and 90 Church Street, New York, NY 10007.

The resulting contract will have an initial term of three (3) years, with two (2) additional one-year renewal options, at NYCHAs sole discretion.

The successful bidder shall pay all applicable taxes and perform all work in accordance with the Form of Proposal (FOP) and all other applicable solicitation and contract documents, including all applicable federal, state, and local laws, rules, and regulations.

Interested vendors may obtain the FOP and all applicable documents by contacting mn.pli@nycha.nyc.gov.
